svg.title: 70 Register as a supplier: company and categories (Mpumudde)
svg.text: Register as a supplier to IDIU
Prequalified suppliers are invited to IDIU's requests for quotations in their categories.
Choose what you supply. Each category lists the documents it needs.

g.text: IDIU checks every document. You'll be told by email when your application
is decided, and 30 days before a document expires.
